steps.description: This is the PowerShell version of the same run. The page notes the line continuations are backticks rather than backslashes, and `$PWD` works the same way.
`docker run -it --rm` opens the interactive container, with the trailing backtick continuing the line. `--add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway` makes `host.docker.internal` resolve on Linux.
`-v "${PWD}:/workspace"` mounts the current directory at `/workspace`, and `-w /workspace` makes it the working directory from the first keystroke.
`--cap-drop ALL` and `--security-opt no-new-privileges` drop kernel capabilities, and `course-agent` names the image to run.
